name: Ruinous buildings, Macau, with distant views of the façade of S. Paulo, Monte Fort and S. Domingos Church
summary: The viewpoint - from high ground in the south-west of the peninsula - allows the artist to include three of the principal landmarks of the city: the façade of the church S.
